Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month, which totals 18.0 days across a full plan year.

Next steps:
- Check your MosaicOne balance
- Review accrual posting dates

Hybrid employees assigned to a hub office must work on site at least 3 days each week. The specific days are set by the team to ensure the team's onsite days overlap and office time is collaborative.

Next steps:
- Confirm your team's anchor days with your manager
- Check MosaicOne for your recorded arrangement

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

The 401(k) retirement plan has no waiting period; employees may begin contributing from their first payroll run.

Basic life insurance and accidental death and dismemberment cover begin when the medical waiting period ends.

Next steps:
- Enroll in benefits during week one
- Check MosaicOne Benefits when coverage begins

Mosaic Robotics will never ask an employee for sensitive data like a bulk personal-data extract over email alone. Genuine internal requests for payroll changes, payment redirections or bulk personal-data extracts are verified by a second channel before anyone acts on them, every time, without exception, regardless of who appears to have sent them.

Recommendation — not company policy: Learn to recognize phishing signals: urgency mismatched to the sender's usual tone, requests to move conversations to personal channels, links where displayed text differs from destination, requests for credentials or security approvals, unexpected attachments, and out-of-the-blue approaches from senior people.

Next steps:
- Forward to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example
- Delete the message
- Do not reply or act

Each employee may claim up to USD 750 per plan year for home office furniture and accessories, including items such as a desk, chair, lamp, footrest, adjustable monitor arm, acoustic treatment, and small filing cabinet.

Next steps:
- Review eligible items in MosaicOne Expenses
- Submit claims before plan year end

Mosaic Robotics provides 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to every eligible new parent, regardless of whether the employee gave birth, adopted, became a parent through surrogacy, or foster placement leading to adoption.

Parental leave eligibility begins after 6 months of continuous service. An employee who becomes a parent before reaching six months receives the statutory entitlement their jurisdiction provides, and the company benefit begins the day the service requirement is met.

An employee who gives birth also receives any period of medical disability leave certified by their clinician before the parental leave begins, paid through short-term disability rather than as parental leave, and it does not reduce the 16 weeks.

Parental leave for both parents where both work at Mosaic Robotics is 16 weeks each; the company does not pool or reduce the entitlement.

Next steps:
- Confirm your 6-month service date with People Operations
- Request leave in MosaicOne at least 30 days in advance
- Contact People Operations to discuss timing and splitting options

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees, covering the room rate only. Local occupancy taxes, resort fees and mandatory service charges are reimbursable above the cap.

The cap rises to USD 350 per night in Boston, New York, San Francisco, London, Zurich and Tokyo, and for any city during a period when a conference the company is attending has inflated local rates. MosaicOne Travel applies the higher cap automatically for those markets.

Where the cap cannot be met—a remote field site with one hotel, a sold-out market—the traveller books the most reasonable available option and notes the reason. No pre-approval is needed.

Next steps:
- Book through MosaicOne Travel
- Check if destination qualifies for higher cap
- Contact MosaicOne Travel for exceptions

A stay of more than 30 consecutive days in another country requires a Tax & Legal review before travel begins. The review determines whether shadow payroll must be opened, whether a certificate of coverage is needed for social security, and whether the employee's planned activities create permanent-establishment exposure.

Tax & Legal review requests must be filed at least 21 calendar days before departure. The request is raised in MosaicOne alongside the manager approval and names the destination, the exact dates, the workspace address and a short description of the work the employee will perform while abroad.

A trip that exceeds 30 consecutive days requires director approval rather than direct-manager approval. Manager approval, director approval and Tax & Legal approval are three separate records and all three must be present before departure.

Work performed outside the home country must use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN. Personal devices may not be used for any Mosaic Robotics work outside the home country.

IT Security must be notified of the destination country at least 5 business days before departure so that conditional-access rules and travel-risk monitoring can be adjusted.

The employee must hold the right to work in the destination country for the whole of the requested period. Mosaic Robotics will confirm employment, provide a letter of assignment and pay for the assignment letter's notarisation where required, and will not sponsor a visa for temporary work abroad.

Employees must have completed at least 12 months of continuous service to work outside their home country and must be in good standing — no active performance improvement plan and no open conduct case.

Next steps:
- File Tax & Legal review 21 days ahead
- Obtain director and Tax & Legal approvals
- Notify IT Security 5 business days prior

Flights must be booked at least 14 calendar days before departure whenever the itinerary is known.

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees.

An itemised receipt is required for every expense of USD 25 or more.

Expense reports USD 2,501 to USD 10,000 require director approval with finance business partner review.

Next steps:
- Book flights 14 days ahead via MosaicOne Travel
- Submit expense report with itemised receipts to director
- Confirm lodging within USD 250/night cap

Security and acceptable-use training must be completed within 14 calendar days of the start date. The full required set for every employee is: security and acceptable use, data protection and privacy, anti-harassment and respectful workplace, and anti-bribery and corruption, all completed within 30 calendar days of the start date.

Benefits enrolment opens in week one even though coverage does not begin until the 90-day waiting period ends. New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date, and have 30 days from the end of the waiting period to make elections in MosaicOne Benefits.

The 401(k) has no waiting period, so a new hire may begin contributing from their first payroll run. Payroll setup, tax withholding elections and 401(k) enrolment are completed in week one.

IT ships standard equipment to arrive at least 5 business days before the start date. The shipment contains the laptop, adapter, headset and, for remote hires, the monitor, keyboard, mouse and dock.

Engineering hires clone the relevant repositories, build the codebase or bring up a bench, and land a first small change by the end of the first week.

Next steps:
- Complete security training by day 14
- Enroll in benefits in week one; elections due within 30 days of day 90
- Begin 401(k) contributions from first payroll

Company laptops are refreshed on a 36-month cycle. MosaicOne opens a refresh ticket automatically 60 days before the anniversary, and IT arranges the swap at a time the employee chooses.

An early laptop refresh requires direct manager approval.

All company equipment must be returned within 5 business days of the final day of employment. IT sends a prepaid, tracked shipping label to remote employees before their final day, and onsite employees hand equipment to their local IT desk.

Next steps:
- Contact your manager to approve the refresh.
- IT will schedule the swap at your convenience.
- Return the old device within 5 business days of separation.

People Operations acknowledges every reported concern within 2 business days. The acknowledgement names the person who will handle the case, explains the process, and sets out what the reporter can expect to be told and when.

Formal investigations are targeted for completion within 30 calendar days of the report. Where an investigation will take longer, the reporter and the respondent are both told, in writing, why and when to expect the outcome.

Severity 1 cases receive a response within 4 business hours. Response means a named human being contacting the person who raised the case, acknowledging what was raised, naming who owns it and describing what happens next.

Next steps:
- Contact Employee Relations for harassment/discrimination reports
- Refer to HR Escalation Policy for severity classification
- Check MosaicOne for ethics line details

Escalation: People Operations — people-ops@mosaicrobotics.example

Next steps:
- Contact People Operations for your assignment details
- Check your MosaicOne employee record
- Confirm onsite expectations with your manager

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance. A request of six or more consecutive business days requires 15 business days of advance notice. Notice is counted in business days between the day the request is submitted in MosaicOne and the first day of the requested absence, excluding both the submission day and any company holiday on the employee's office calendar.

Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month, posted to the employee's MosaicOne balance on the first calendar day of each month.

PTO accrual stops once an employee's balance reaches 30.0 days. The cap is a ceiling on the balance, not an annual limit on what may be earned: once the employee uses enough PTO to bring the balance below 30.0 days, accrual resumes at the next posting date.

Recommendation — not company policy: Your PTO balance as of 1 September 2026 is 13.5 days remaining. Before taking PTO, confirm the specific dates you need and calculate the business days between your submission date and the first day of absence to ensure you meet the 5-business-day minimum (or 15 business days for six or more consecutive days).

Next steps:
- Determine your requested dates and duration.
- Submit the request in MosaicOne with sufficient advance notice.
- Obtain written manager approval before the absence begins.

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance.

Every PTO request requires written approval from your direct manager in MosaicOne. Verbal agreement, messages in chat and email threads are insufficient on their own.

Recommendation — not company policy: Your request meets the notice requirement (8 business days submitted) and your balance covers it (13.5 days available as of 2026-09-01). Submit the request in MosaicOne now so your manager can record written approval.

Requests overlapping the 2026 year-end blackout (22–23 December) require director approval; your September dates do not overlap it.

Next steps:
- Submit request in MosaicOne for manager approval
- Manager approves in writing in the system
- Time off is confirmed once approved

Ireland is an approved destination for temporary work abroad.

Your proposed stay from 1 October to 20 October 2026 is 20 consecutive calendar days, which falls within the 30-day threshold.

Recommendation — not company policy: You must still obtain written manager approval at least 21 calendar days before departure, raise the request in MosaicOne under 'Work from another country' with exact dates and workspace address, and confirm your laptop meets the device and connectivity requirements (company-managed, full-disk-encrypted, always-on VPN). Notify IT Security of the destination at least 5 business days before departure.

Next steps:
- Raise manager approval request in MosaicOne by 10 September 2026.
- Confirm travel laptop is company-managed and encrypted.
- Notify IT Security 5 business days before 1 October.

You have completed 45 months of continuous service as of 2026-09-01, exceeding the 12-month minimum required to work outside your home country.

Your proposed stay of 42 consecutive calendar days (3 November to 14 December) exceeds the 30-day threshold and requires director approval and a Tax & Legal review before travel begins.

Germany is an approved destination for temporary work abroad.

Your 42-day stay falls within the rolling 90-day annual limit for work outside your home country.

You may not sign contracts or negotiate customer agreements on behalf of Mosaic Robotics while abroad, regardless of job title or trip length.

Recommendation — not company policy: Raise your request in MosaicOne under 'Work from another country' at least 21 calendar days before 3 November, naming the destination, exact dates, and workspace address in Berlin.

Recommendation — not company policy: File a Tax & Legal review request in MosaicOne alongside your manager approval, at least 21 calendar days before departure. The review will determine shadow payroll, social security coverage, and permanent-establishment exposure.

Recommendation — not company policy: Notify IT Security of your Berlin destination at least 5 business days before departure so that conditional-access rules and travel-risk monitoring can be adjusted.

Next steps:
- File manager, director and Tax & Legal approvals in MosaicOne by 13 October 2026.
- Confirm your travel laptop meets encryption and VPN requirements with IT Security.
- Contact mobility@mosaicrobotics.example with any questions about the approval process.

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

The waiting period is not restarted by an internal transfer, a promotion, or a change from part-time to full-time status. It is restarted by a break in service of more than 26 weeks.

Retirement plan eligibility is different: an employee may begin contributing to the 401(k) plan from their first payroll run, with no waiting period at all.

Escalation: To calculate your specific waiting period end date, contact People Operations at benefits@mosaicrobotics.example with your hire date.

Next steps:
- Provide your hire date to People Operations
- Confirm coverage start date in MosaicOne Benefits
- Review election options within 30 days
